title: Answer: everything individual experiences, few occasions are conscious

statements.text: Every individual actual entity, from the most trivial puff of existence to God, has experience, but most experience is not conscious. Aggregates such as rocks have no overall experience. Consciousness belongs to high-grade occasions such as the presiding occasions of higher animals.

sources.quote: God is an actual entity, and so is the most trivial puff of existence in far-off empty space
In such things (such as a rock) or events (such as a rock concert), there is no overall experience, therefore no mentality.
